criteria.basis: High-risk candidates are admitted only when source class is permitted by ATLAS_PREDICATE_AUTHORITY_REGISTRY, evidence class is SOURCE_EXPLICIT or LINEAGE_EXPLICIT, source currentness is CURRENT, and required scope dimensions are present.

OWNS/GOVERNS do not silently use source precedence to select among competing admissible owners; distinct current admissible values emit CONFLICTING/OWNER_CONFLICT. Other high-risk predicates use registry-defined precedence and preserve equal-rank disagreement as conflict.

Explicit DENIED controls grants; RESERVED controls absent denial; grants require all six authority intersection factors to be explicitly ALLOW; missing/unknown factors resolve UNRESOLVED rather than GRANTED.
Resolver requires a scope dimensions object, rejects missing predicate-required dimensions, groups by exact scope hash, and preserves the supplied scope rather than inventing absent dimensions.

GRT adapter preserves exact evidence classes. CANDIDATE_RELATION/INFERRED and corroborating technical classes cannot satisfy the high-risk resolver evidence admission; GRT OWNED_BY/GOVERNED_BY candidate observations are explicitly denied high-risk semantic promotion.
Owner and equal-precedence predicate conflicts retain all competing candidate IDs in an explicit open conflict record; no winner is selected.
